title: VTC: document Chat delegation pattern
description: The draft silently omits in-call chat, lobby chat, reactions, polls, captions, and invites — all of which JMAP Chat handles when the binding is present. This reads as a gap rather than a design choice. Add a section (or expand the existing Relationship to JMAP Chat section) explicitly stating: in-call chat is the bound Chat, lobby communication uses the Chat, in-call ephemeral reactions can use Chat WSS events, live captions are Chat ephemeral events with speaker attribution, and scheduled-call invitees are derived from Space membership or CalendarEvent invitees. Make the delegation explicit so it reads as architecture, not omission.
close_reason: Expanded Relationship to JMAP Chat section to explicitly document delegation: in-call chat, reactions, captions, lobby chat, invitees, access control, active call banner. Changed from optional to recommended.
